points.text: U.K. police arrested five men on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act and explosives offenses after vehicles were spotted near RAF Fairford; investigators are examining a possible Iran connection.
South Africa beat Australia by 32 runs in Johannesburg to secure the ODI series, with centuries from Temba Bavuma and David Miller.
Team Europe defeated Team World 13-5 to win the Laver Cup after Alexander Zverev beat Learner Tien on the final day.

articles.title: British Police Arrest 5 Near Air Base Used By U.S. In Potential Terror Probe
articles.description: The men were arrested on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act and explosives offenses after three vans were seen heading to RAF Fairford.

articles.title: Five arrested near UK air base used by U.S. bombers in Iran war
articles.description: U.K. police say five men were arrested on suspicion of preparation of a terrorist act after three vehicles were spotted near an air base the U.S. military has been using to launch attacks on Iran.

articles.title: Five arrested near UK-US base in Iran terror probe
articles.description: Investigators are examining a possible Iran connection after suspicious vehicles were stopped near RAF Fairford

articles.title: U.K. police arrest 5 men near air base, suspected of preparing terror act
articles.description: Police said Sunday that the men were detained on suspicion of offenses under the Explosives Act, and that army bomb-disposal experts were examining several vehicles.

topics.summary: U.K. police arrested five men on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act and explosives offenses after three vehicles were spotted near RAF Fairford. Army bomb-disposal experts examined several vehicles, and investigators are examining a possible Iran connection.

articles.description: Team Europe took a 3-1 lead over Team World on Friday's opening day of the Laver Cup after Carlos Alcaraz and Jakub Mensik sealed the final point with a doubles victory in London.

articles.description: (Photo credit: Geoff Burke) World No. 2 Alexander Zverev of Germany finished off Learner Tien 7-6 (3), 6-3, and Team Europe clinched a dominant 13-5 win over Team World at the Laver Cup on Sunday in London. Europe led the competition 7-5 after two days, and each match was worth three points on the…
